intent: Make estate metadata report the field capacity from the field schedule while leaving hive capacity and pricing behavior unchanged.
rationale: EstateResponse.maxFields is the second constructor value, but GameStateService supplied EstatePrices.MAX_HIVES there. Replacing only that argument with EstatePrices.MAX_FIELDS directly repairs the reported field capacity and preserves every other estate value.
public_checks: Inspected the supplied EstatePrices and public capacity tests: fields stop at 8 via MAX_FIELDS while hives stop at 6 via MAX_HIVES.
Ran the frozen public guard command; it could not start because the supplied Maven wrapper attempted to fetch Maven 3.9.16 and network access is unavailable.
uncertainties: Frozen public tests were not executed because the supplied Maven wrapper requires a network download unavailable in the isolated environment.
Reserved evaluator behavior is intentionally unknown and was not inspected.
